LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruit.label: Feather Shadow from Another Realm
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruit.letterText: A feather-shaped projection has appeared near the colony. She introduces herself as Neiyu, a Milira's projection in this world. Looking around with curiosity, she smiles and asks whether she may stay. You may welcome her or let the projection disperse.
